National Institute of Science and Technology · Coordinator

INCT ID-ICED

Institute for Democracy: Institutions, Behavior, Public Sphere and Diversity

A National Institute of Science and Technology based at IESP–UERJ, dedicated to studying challenges and threats to democracy in comparative perspective. It connects institutions, political behavior and the public sphere with inclusion and sustainability in Brazil and South America.

LEMEP · General coordination

Manchetômetro

How do the media portray Brazilian politics? Established in 2014, Manchetômetro monitors coverage of politics and the economy, producing analyses of the press and public debate.

Research groups and observatories

Coordinator

LEMEP

Laboratory for Media and Public Sphere Studies

Research on political communication, public opinion formation and the role of the media in democracy. The laboratory analyzes the press and social media, connecting academic research with public debate.

  • Political communication
  • Public opinion
  • Media and democracy
Visit LEMEP ↗
Coordinator

GEMAA

Multidisciplinary Study Group on Affirmative Action

Founded in 2008, the group studies affirmative action policies and the representation of race and gender in education, media, politics and other areas of social life. It produces surveys and analyses of inequality in Brazil.

  • Affirmative action
  • Racial inequality
  • Race and gender
Visit GEMAA ↗
Coordinator

OLB

Brazilian Legislative Observatory

Research and analysis of Brazil’s legislature and legislative behavior. The observatory connects academic knowledge with the study and monitoring of political institutions.

  • Brazilian legislature
  • Legislative behavior
  • Representation

Research projects

Listed since 2024

Monitoring the public sphere

Disinformation and bias in traditional and social media

A continuation of Manchetômetro’s work, analyzing content in the press and on social media. The project combines content analysis, valence analysis and AI-assisted coding tools.

Participant · Listed since 2023

Proyecto 3Ps

Populism, polarization and post-truth

An international network studying populism, polarization and post-truth in digital communication. The Brazilian team, based at IESP–UERJ, analyzes affective polarization and populist communication in the 2018 and 2022 elections.

Steering committee member · 2018–2024

Institute for Democracy and the Democratization of Communication

INCT · Research network

A multi-institutional project on Brazilian democracy, public opinion and media organization. João Feres Júnior served on its steering committee from 2018 to 2024. This research continues through INCT ID-ICED, which he currently coordinates.

Completed · 2022

Race and Voting 2022

Race relations and electoral preferences

Qualitative research on the relationship between race and political and electoral preferences. The study conducted 40 online focus groups across eight Brazilian state capitals.

Completed · 2005–2012

Iberconceptos

Comparative conceptual history of the Ibero-American world

Coordination of collective studies of political and social concepts in Brazil, across two research phases. This work forms part of a broader research trajectory in conceptual history.

Completed · 2017–2022

Historical Authenticity

Populism and claims to authenticity

A comparative project on the relationship between populism and authenticity in different social contexts, with studies of Brazil, India and Ukraine and collaboration across countries and disciplines.
